fields.System.Title: FDN-6 — Master data: products
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Define the things the warehouse holds stock of, with the identity, physical attributes, and
handling flags that every other module depends on.

Scope

In. Product records, multiple barcodes, units of measure and conversions, tracking flags,
bulk import, discontinuation, frozen-field enforcement.

Out. Pricing. Product content and images. Purchasing and supplier catalogues.

Design notes

product_id and sku are different fields. This is the highest-value design decision in
the whole system. SKU codes get renumbered — catalogue refreshes, supplier changes, mergers. If
SKU is the primary key, that means rewriting every historical row. If it is an attribute, it is
a one-row update.

Barcodes are a list, not a field. A product commonly has a unit EAN, a different case code,
an internal label, and an old code still on stock received two years ago. All must scan to the
same product. A single barcode column forces manual typing, and typed codes are wrong codes.

Tracking flags branch five modules. requires_batch, requires_serial, requires_expiry
each add a path in receiving, putaway, allocation, picking, and counting. Recommendation: batch
and expiry in v1, serial at Stage 4.

Some fields must freeze once stock exists. Changing case_quantity silently changes what
every existing balance means. FDN-607 enforces this; the documented alternative is to create
a new product.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| SKU used as a technical key | [doc 03 §7.2](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Wrong case quantity multiplies across every transaction | [doc 03 §7.1](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Missing barcode forces manual entry and wrong-item picks | [doc 03 §7.3](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Duplicate products split stock | [doc 03 §7.5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Frozen field changed while stock exists | [doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md) |
| Partial bulk import | [doc 09 §11.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
